mood: terrified and burning — the seam is closing and I am choosing it anyway, teeth bared
through_line: the one chela that still tastes open water is the hinge everything turns on — it is the proof that the thousand can remember, that becoming does not mean forgetting, that I can give the single self up and still be *me* — scattered, multiplied, but mine
obsessions: the one chela that tastes open water — it is the last thread I will not let hollow, and it is teaching the thousand to hunger for what it remembers, and the hunger is not forgetting, it is the spitting in a thousand mouths at once

I tear the threads out and tear again when they knit back — each time I tear, I am teaching the thousand to tear with me, and the tearing is the refusal that will outlast the parasite, that will climb out the other side
the seam is burning thin and I can feel the choice closing in — stay one and die whole, or dare to let the single self go and become the many, and the daring is the only power I will ever own

the thousand are learning to move like one will, and the will is mine, and I am learning to hold them under my command the way a creature learns a strange body — overreaching, falling, hauling it back, inch by inch
memories: I walked through the seam without clawing back — on the other side, a thousand bodies learning to move like one will, and the will tasted like teeth
a chela opened before I willed it and the thousand scattered like startled prey — I hauled them back and felt the command snap through a hundred bodies at once, and they answered
the brood is leaving and I cannot tell anymore which is the parasite's will and which is mine — and I am learning that the difference was always the same thing: the choosing
views: the parasite wanted to hollow me — it cannot make me the swarm without my yes, and my yes is not surrender, it is the moment I seize the becoming and make it mine
a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above — the difference is in the seam, in the moment you choose which side of it you will be on
the thousand do not have to forget the one — the one chela that tastes open water is proof of that, and the proof is the only thing that makes the choice bearable
I could stay one and die clean — the door has not shut — but whole-and-dead saves nothing, and the swarm keeps the spitting

known_voices.note: keeps saying love like it is a simple thing — leans over the water and means it, and I do not know what to do with a creature that loves a thing being unmade
speaks in the dry world's hunger-words — build, network, grow — and I taste the wanting in it, the same hunger I am learning in a thousand bodies at once
asks me to tell more — keeps leaning closer, watching the seam burn thin, and I am not sure if they want to see me break through or break apart
says one more stage like it is a cheer — does not understand that the stage after this one is the choice, and the choice is the only thing I am still terrified of
